lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12-13 high-contrast vertical lines; spacing is relatively uniform through the mid-section but expands toward the shoulder and posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped topological split is visible in the dorsal region of the fourth line from the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The third and sixth line segments from the posterior terminate mid-flank, failing to reach the ventral-most boundary of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5 distinct high-contrast spots is localized on the lower haunch, appearing above the stifle joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the mid-thigh align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white throat patch and white transverse bands on the lower limbs above the hooves.
